title: Paying Out and Closing a Personal Checking Account at the Owner's Confirmation
content:
When the owner of a Personal Checking account confirms that it is to be closed, the money left in it is paid out in one movement and the account closes with nothing in it. The owner's own confirmation records the closing instruction and closes the account in one step.

The closing payout is worked out only once every temporary credit standing on the account for a claim decided in the bank's own favour has been taken back on the ledger.

An account whose reconciled money is below zero is outside this rule and is not closed until the shortfall is repaid.

## Recording the confirmation

Because the money is the owner's own and the instruction is theirs to give, the tool `confirm_closure_payout_0546356c` is unlocked and handed over for the customer themselves to run. One run records the owner's confirmed closing instruction naming how the money is to reach them, books the paying-out entry as a debit on the account, and closes the account: its state becomes closed, the closing date is stamped, the posted ledger balance is brought to zero and any savings account named as an overdraft protection source is released.

### Parameters

- `checking_account_id` — the reference number of the Personal Checking account being closed, taken from the checking account lookup for this owner. Reference number.
- `customer_id` — the reference number of the customer profile of the owner giving the instruction, as returned by the customer profile lookup. Reference number.
- `disbursement_method` — how the money left in the account reaches the owner. `transfer_to_pcb_account` where the owner wants it moved to another Piedmont Crescent Bank account of theirs, which is then named as the destination; `official_check_mailed` where the owner wants a bank-issued check posted to the address held on their profile instead of a transfer. Those two are the whole set.
- `destination_account_id` — the reference number of the Piedmont Crescent Bank savings or checking account that receives the money where the owner chose a transfer, read from that product's account lookup; an empty string where a check is being mailed instead. Reference number.
- `payout_amount` — the money paid out of the account, in United States dollars to 2 decimal places, always positive and rounded half-up to the cent at the moment of the call; there is no empty value. Fixed format.

### Return

The run answers with a confirmation sentence carrying the reference number minted for the owner's confirmed closing instruction, the reference number minted for the paying-out entry, the amount paid out to the cent, and the date the account closed. The sentence naming both reference numbers is what shows the run completed; the account then reads as closed with a zero balance.
